messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-2026-5874 triggered against service: inference-runtime-prod. Urgency: high. Symptom: sustained 5xx spike + tail latency > 2s across region us-west-2. Initial trigger at 2026-03-14T01:02:47Z. Notified primary: @alice (oncall). Incident key: PD-2026-5874. Console: https://pagerduty.example/PD-2026-5874

alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on my phone, traveling, can try to access laptop in ~4m. Any quick mitigation steps?

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-5874 acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 2026-03-14T01:03:02Z.

incident-bot: Escalation timer 5m started. If not acknowledged by backup, will escalate to secondary.

alice (oncall): I can confirm clients are seeing 503s. Checking Redwood console now.

alice (oncall): Observing a spike in model-serving-worker OOMs on node gpu-pool-7. Error snippet: `runtime error: failed to allocate queue buffer`

incident-bot: 01:08:03Z — Escalation: primary missed extended ack window. Paging secondary: @bob (secondary). Manager notification to @carla (eng-manager) sent.

bob (secondary): Acked and on it. Taking ownership since alice is unavailable. Handoff notes: start by reverting component deprod/model-cache-rollout v1.3.2 -> v1.3.1 if rollout was within last 10m. Also check autoscaler events and node memory pressure.

carla (eng-manager): Thanks @bob. Keep me posted on customer impact and timeline. If rollback needed, coordinate with @dave for safe host restarts.

bob (secondary): Running quick checks.

bob (secondary): `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep model-serving`

bob (secondary): Output: 
``` 
model-serving-47ffd  1/1 CrashLoopBackOff  0  3m  gpu-pool-7
model-serving-5a3c2  1/1 Running  128m  gpu-pool-3
``` 

bob (secondary): Logs from model-serving-47ffd: `fatal: allocator failed: insufficient device memory`

dave (sre): Jumping in to check node metrics. GPU host gpu-pool-7 showing memory fragmentation and multiple CUDA OOMs across containers. Suspect recent model-cache change increased KV cache prefetch size.

bob (secondary): Rolling back the model-cache rollout now. Patch: set CACHE_PREFETCH=0.5 -> 0.2 and redeploy config.

bob (secondary): `kubectl set env deployment/model-cache CACHE_PREFETCH=0.2 -n inference && kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-cache -n inference`

incident-bot: Automated job started: rollback job id rb-91 initiated by bob at 2026-03-14T01:12:21Z.

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-5874: escalation to manager (carla) confirmed at 2026-03-14T01:12:40Z.

dave (sre): Restarted affected pods on gpu-pool-7 after cordoning ephemeral unhealthy instances. Observed immediate drop in 5xx rate to baseline within ~90s.

bob (secondary): Confirming traffic now within SLO for inference-runtime-prod. No further OOMs in last 3m. Rolling forward stabilization monitoring for 10m.

emma (support): Drafting customer-facing note for impacted customers in us-west-2. ETA for full verification: 10m. Will queue PSR update once stabilised.

carla (eng-manager): Good job. Postmortem owners: bob (tech lead) + dave (sre) to lead write-up. Alice will add handoff notes. Emma to capture customer timeline.

bob (secondary): Adding immediate mitigation checklist to incident ticket: reduce prefetch, restart pods on impacted hosts, uncordon after health checks, monitor kv-cache hit rates.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 2026-03-14T01:18:59Z. Monitoring period started.

alice (oncall): Back at laptop and reviewed notes. Thanks all for the handoff. I will follow up on why the cache prefetch default changed in the rollout pipeline.

carla (eng-manager): We also need to review alert thresholds — PD alerted on 5xx+latency but OOM symptoms surfaced before aggregated metrics tripped; consider adding host-level OOM alarms.

bob (secondary): Agreed. I'll add a follow-up action: host CUDA OOM metric -> PagerDuty alert with 3m aggregation.

emma (support): Customer bulletin posted to status with initial summary. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-2026-5874

dave (sre): Leaving final note: all systems stable. Will run longer-term memory defrag job on gpu-pool-7 off-peak.

incident-bot: Thread closed by bob at 2026-03-14T01:23:19Z.
